versions.changelog:
anymermaid-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release: Generate diagrams using Mermaid syntax and render via mmdc CLI into SVG/PNG/PDF files.
- Supports 26 official Mermaid diagram types, including process, flowchart, sequence, class, ER, Gantt, mindmap, pie, timeline, Git graph, Kanban, and more.
- Workflow includes chart type detection, context-sensitive syntax loading, optional syntax dry-run, and efficient rendering for small diagrams (stdin).
- Cross-platform support (macOS, Linux, Windows); includes shell command examples and platform-specific instructions.
- Detailed error handling for mmdc installation and headless environments.
- Provides advanced configuration options for themes, fonts, sandboxes, and Markdown batch rendering.
